trait.name: Bloodied Fury
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the quaggoth has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quaggoth makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, or 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Slashing damage if the quaggoth is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.
